page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6.26xlarge is a bare-metal server instance belonging to the ECS Bare Metal family. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture, it delivers 104 dedicated virtual cores paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core.

The platform features 32 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to facilitate high-throughput communication across distributed nodes. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for all stateful filesystem operations. Additionally, it contains no discrete GPU acceleration hardware.

By eliminating virtualization overhead, the instance offers direct hardware access and predictable compute density across its 104 cores. This configuration fits large-scale enterprise deployments, multi-tenant container orchestration clusters, continuous integration builds, and high-concurrency web applications.
